# Incremental Perps review

## Summary

The previous request for provider-scoped Cross eligibility is addressed for provider-tagged markets. `usePerpsProOrderForm` passes the selected provider to `usePerpsMarketData`, which now checks provider as well as symbol. The focused tests put the other provider first and exercise isolated-only metadata on both sides. The selected Pro form remounts on symbol/provider changes. No new actionable changed-line finding was established.

## Criteria outcomes

The 25 row outcomes and supporting paths are in `review-criteria.md`. Row 21 and part of row 22 lack external checkout evidence, so this is COMMENT rather than APPROVE. No new Core API or package revision is part of the PR-specific fix.

## Prior finding

Resolved for tagged duplicate markets: the earlier symbol-only lookup could select another provider's `onlyIsolated` restriction at `app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsProMarketView/components/PerpsProOrderForm/usePerpsProOrderForm.ts:885`. The fix passes `market.providerId` at line 793, and `app/components/UI/Perps/hooks/usePerpsMarketData.ts:98` matches it. No duplicate finding is retained.

## Findings

None supported by the available changed-line evidence. The untagged fallback's behavior with mixed tagged/untagged provider records is not established without the Core producer contract. The existing tests establish a lone untagged record, not a mixed result.

## Evidence and limitations

Inspected the prior-head-to-current-head comparison, the four files in the latest PR fix, Pro form/provider routing, and existing chooser/order-builder tests. The task includes iOS recipe logs and screenshots, but this static review did not independently run or validate an app. No dependencies were installed and no tests were executed. The frozen workspace lacks Core and Extension revisions for producer/parity inspection. The large incremental Git comparison also contains unrelated mainline updates, not treated as changes in this PR fix.

## Recommended action

COMMENT. Run QA on the flag-on Hyperliquid Cross placement and Scale flow, the flag-off and isolated-only cases, and provider-duplicate markets. Check Core's tagging contract and Extension parity at pinned revisions before granting full cross-client approval. Keep the production flag off until the separate resting-order lock lands, as the frozen task describes.
